name: Rain
overview: Scripture reveals that rain is a divine provision essential for life, as seen before the flood when God had not yet caused rain to fall (Genesis 2:5). The great flood during Noah's time was marked by forty days and nights of continuous rain, demonstrating God's sovereign control over nature to execute judgment (Genesis 7:4, 7:12). This event underscores both the power of God to send rain as a means of judgment and His authority over the earth's waters (Genesis 7:11, 7:17).
